posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked:
@International Backers

All of your orders have shipped, so you should be getting noticies (and packages!). I know that international shipping on this project was super expensive, but at least the fact that it is also super fast might make up for it a bit :)

@Domestic Backers

No one got any shipping notices over the weekend because FedEx does not do pickups on the weekend. We, however, do pack on the weekends (and in the middle of the night, and all day). We have now returned to packing Domestic Orders after taking a pause in the early "J"'s (alpha by *first* name, remember) to pack International Orders in order to get them out by the FedEx Express deadline (unlike Ground orders, Express orders *must* ship on the exact date pre-specified on the label). SInce the plurality of first names evidently start with "J", getting through those took a long time. All of the "J"s and the first half or so of the "K"'s will be shipped today. We will be working our way through the rest of the alphabet this week (we have about 700 boxes left to go out of the ~2000 or so that we started out with). The remaining letters with tons of names are M, R, S and T.
